# ViBRo Navigator

> Lightweight, offline-first Android GPS navigation with minimal on-screen, voice, and vibration guidance, powered by BRouter.

ViBRo Navigator is an Android navigation app designed for roads, trails, cities, and other routes. It emphasizes offline operation, vibration-based guidance, a map-free compass view, and a lightweight interface.

## Site

- [Homepage](./): Product overview, screenshots, features, navigation details, and downloads.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/damianofalcioni/ViBRo-Navigator): Source code, documentation, issues, and development history.
- [Latest GitHub release](https://github.com/damianofalcioni/ViBRo-Navigator/releases/latest): Latest release artifacts.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=vibro.navigator): Google Play distribution page.
- [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/vibro.navigator/): F-Droid distribution page.

## Key characteristics

- Android GPS navigation.
- Offline-first routing using BRouter.
- Vibration, voice, and minimal on-screen guidance.
- Map-free compass-oriented navigation view.
- Open-source project hosted on GitHub.
